title: 第六章 潜入别院 万家遇险第七章 院锁邪物 楼藏幽魂
content_zh:
“该死的臭丫头怎么会在这里？”小虫子低头嘟囔着。而另一边好奇的白衣女孩一直盯着他，似乎就等着他再次抬头的那一刻。小虫子灵机一动，一抬头做了个鬼脸，朝女孩吐了口口水，然后得意洋洋地撇过头去。这下可气坏了白衣女孩，提着缰绳就要过去。木须子微微一笑，“莹儿！”说罢，拦住了女孩，然后对其耳语一番。只见女孩低着头，紧咬贝齿，双手拨弄着青蛇鞭，看样子火气就要爆发了！一番耳语过后，莹儿抬头再次向拐角望去，男孩却消失不见了。
此时，教场上人声嘈杂，衣袂遮天，各色人等都互相招呼寒暄。忽然，只听场中震天价响，不知有什么大人物进场，远远望去，只见这伙人身骑高头大马，个个灰色劲装，头戴华冠，披风架身，虎背熊腰，甚是威猛。而打头的两名锦衣卫同知腰悬金牌，器宇不凡。一名身披红色披风，英姿飒爽，眉宇间看出却是个女子。另一位身披白色披风，头部高高抬起，一副趾高气扬的样子。他们正是朝廷中赫赫有名的锦衣卫首领火凤凰与白凤凰。入场后，无论是同僚还是武林高手都上前与之寒暄、问候。
“差不多了，该进去了。”木须子拉起执拗的莹儿，向着教场走去。此刻与会的武林人士到得已十之*，放眼望去，数百席位渐渐坐满。巳时近末，鼓乐声渐止，教场上众卫军一齐肃立，静静等待着万锦王入场。
再说小虫子，打从狗洞钻进去之后，三转五转便混进了灶房。一看就是平时偷吃惯了。现在的小虫子正将手指放在嘴中饶有兴致地咂了又咂，烧鸡的味道还真是不错！厚厚的油脂沿着托盘淌了出来，焦黄色的脆皮曲卷起来，裸露出嫩生生的鲜肉，层层叠叠，瞧一眼便让人馋虫抓心。
十来个掌厨的在灶房里面来回穿梭着，翻炒声、吆喝声、剁肉声，声声不绝于耳。绫罗绣花的大桌布挂在弄堂之前，桌上摆满了青椒，嫩笋、芹菜等各色鲜蔬。而桌子下面藏着的小鬼头正乐呵呵的享用着美食。偶尔桌布在那里来回摆动，忙碌碌的一堆人也无暇顾及。
不多时，一阵剧烈的咳嗽声传来，声音越来越近。等到临近摆桌时，只听“咕咚”一声，古旧的桌子随之一震。小虫子吓得差点喊出声来。
“哎呦，我说徐管家，您亲自过来干嘛，有小的伺候、看管着呢。小心着点，您本来身子就不好，这是着哪门子急啊？”“臭小子，锦爷来了！”“啊？亲自来？真不知道锦爷怎么想的，居然花万两黄金，亲自请了一帮武林中人来坐镇万锦别院！咱们王爷身份何等尊贵，怎能屈尊与这些不入眼的布衣杂碎交好！”“啪！”不等这个年轻人说完，这个老头一巴掌拍在了他头上“闭嘴！”老头转过身道：“嗌，你们都给我听好了！这些东西务必在在午时弄完。王爷这次特地请了卜卦师，再三交代，午时若在动刀具，必会迁怒凶神，坐映灾星！”小虫子闻声撇撇嘴，继续埋头啃着鸡骨头。
别院外面喧闹嘈杂，灶房里面美味佳肴，可是万在锦王的书房里面，气氛却有点诡异。
“金刀门门主胡霸天”，“紫宵洞左使伏云霜”，“水神帮副舵陶飞”，“麓山真人萧长风”，“风毒子唐不浅”。。。一个瘦高个太监一边捡着竹牌，一边念叨着。声音是那么地颤抖、不自然。而在他旁边伫立着一个矮胖的太监，正自低着头，双手战战兢兢地捧着一方被金色锦缎包裹着的檀木盘，盘中零星地摆满了小竹牌。
“哎呦喂”一个妖娆的，令人极不舒服的声音突然响起“这都是些什么杂碎啊？”一位满头银发、身材臃肿，目光却犀利似剑的老太监拿起手帕捂着嘴笑道：“你们两个狗奴才，怎么给小王爷办事的啊？花费万两黄金买来就是这些无用的‘护身符’吗？这不是让奴家看笑话吗？”说完伸出兰花指抚了抚花白的眉毛。此人正是大太监余入海！
两个小太监闻声哆哆嗦嗦，忽地“扑通”一声，同时跪倒“公公饶命、公公饶命。。。”两颗脑袋如同捣蒜一般磕个没完。
“余公公有所不知，时间仓促，而就在昨晚，我父亲的枕边，女婢们发现了这个！”说完他拿起一块褐色令牌，令牌的材质似乎是某种胡杨木，在其顶部是一块悉心雕琢的恶鬼头像，上面赫然写着三个大字“鬼煞令”。
余公公撰在手中一瞧，不禁脱口而出“幽冥鬼府？”随即顿了顿，然后悠悠地说道：“青城啊，你家得罪的可不是一般人啊！”
“这是我家第二次收到鬼煞令，第一次收到是在一个月前，父亲刚刚患病之时。短短一个月能招纳这些好手已是极不容易了。”
“公公一番好意，青城铭记在心。只是。。。这些人与公公的盖世神功相比，自然不值一提，但若要放眼于当今武林，这些高手也足以能算得上是举足轻重的人物！公公也不大必担心。青城作为晚辈，打小便把余公公当做干爹一般，甚知您与家父交情颇为深厚。如今，家父染上邪气，又得余公公如此体己关怀，亲自登门探望，青城真不知该如何报答！”这位八面玲珑、自称“青城”的小王爷正是万锦王的独子万青城！
“好了、好了”公公扭头看着旁边一身锦衣玉带，面目俊朗的年轻人说道：“小王爷，我已经探望过你父亲，本应离开。但你故意留奴家在雅居喝茶闲聊，是有什么事情吗？再不说，奴家可要走了！”公公一脸不悦，正要扶案起身。
万青城立马陪着笑脸，上前扶住了余公公，说道：“您是从小看着青城长大的，我这点小九九自然也逃不过公公的眼睛。无论朝野还是武林，谁人没听说过‘寒芒爪’余公公呢？所以，我希望您能留下来，虎镇山岗！”
“哈哈”还没等万青城说完，公公便乐开了花：“臭小子，就你嘴甜，哈哈。。。”
“哈哈。。。”两个小太监也堆着一脸谄媚陪着嬉笑。
突然，余公公猛地一转身，袖起手落，两手分别擒住了这两颗脑袋。手指一曲，十指的指甲竟诡异变长，硬生生地插进两颗头颅。然后顺势一带，如同提烧鹅一般将两具尸首抛在五丈之外！这些动作只在一瞬之间，两张脸还挂着微笑，声音还未歇止，身体却像抽去了脊梁骨一般散开了架。他们手里的木盘、竹牌顿时撒落一地。

“没大没小！”余公公冷冷地丢下这一句话，厌恶地摆摆手，起身离开。惊愕之中的万青城还没回过神来，只是呆呆地僵立着，眼一眨不眨地盯着两具正自喷血的尸首，一脸地煞白。
“你老万家的事我不会不管的，你就不用瞎操心了！”声音渐渐飘远。。。
content_en:
"Why is that damn stinky girl here?" The little insect lowered his head and muttered. The curious girl in white on the other side kept staring at him, as if waiting for the moment he looked up again. The little insect had an idea, raised his head, made a face, spat at the girl, and then turned his head away triumphantly. The girl in white was so angry now that she held up the reins and was about to pass. Musuzi smiled slightly, "Ying'er!" After saying that, he stopped the girl and whispered to her. The girl lowered her head, clenched her teeth, and fiddled with the green snake whip with both hands. It looked like her anger was about to explode! After whispering, Ying'er raised her head and looked around the corner again, but the boy disappeared.
At this time, the teaching ground was noisy with people, their clothes covered the sky, and people of all kinds were greeting each other. Suddenly, there was a huge roar in the field, and someone unknown came into the field. Looking from a distance, I saw this group of people riding tall horses, all wearing gray clothes, wearing crowns and capes, and they were very powerful. The first two guards in uniforms have gold medals hanging on their waists, and they are extraordinary. One person was wearing a red cloak and had a heroic appearance, but it could be seen from her brows that she was a woman. The other one was wearing a white cloak, with his head raised high, looking arrogant. They were Huo Fenghuang and Bai Fenghuang, the famous leaders of the Jinyi Guards in the imperial court. After entering the venue, both colleagues and martial arts masters came up to greet him.
"It's almost time, it's time to go in." Musuzi pulled up the stubborn Ying'er and walked towards the teaching field. At this time, ten of the martial arts people attending the meeting had arrived. Looking around, hundreds of seats were gradually filled. At the end of the hour, the sound of drumming gradually stopped, and all the guards on the teaching field stood in awe, quietly waiting for King Wanjin to enter.
As for the little bugs, after getting in through the dog hole, they sneaked into the kitchen in three or five turns. At first glance, it seems that I am used to eating secretly. Now the little insect is putting his fingers in his mouth and slurping it with great interest. The roasted chicken tastes really good! Thick grease dripped out along the tray, and the crispy brown skin curled up, exposing the tender and fresh meat.
A dozen or so chefs were shuttled back and forth in the kitchen, the sounds of stir-frying, shouting, and chopping meat could be heard all the time. A large silk-embroidered tablecloth was hung in front of the alley. The table was filled with green peppers, young bamboo shoots, celery and other fresh vegetables. The little ghost hidden under the table is happily enjoying the food. Occasionally the tablecloth swings back and forth, and the busy crowd has no time to notice.
Not long after, a violent coughing sound came, and the sound got closer and closer. When it was time to set the table, I heard a "dong" sound, and the ancient table shook. The little insect was so frightened that he almost shouted.
"Hey, Butler Xu, what are you doing here in person? There are young people waiting and watching over you. Be careful, you are not in good health to begin with. Why are you so anxious?" "Bad boy, Master Jin is here!" "Ah? Come in person? I don't know what Master Jin is thinking. He actually spent ten thousand taels of gold to personally invite a group of martial arts people to come and take charge of Wanjin Villa! How could our prince have such a noble status, how could he condescend to be incompatible with these things? The old man slapped him on the head. "Shut up!" "Hey, please listen to this!" It must be done at noon. This time, the prince specially invited a fortune teller and told him again and again that if he uses the knife at noon, he will be angry with the evil god and bring disaster. " The little insect curled his lips when he heard this and continued to chew on the chicken bones.
There was a lot of noise outside the courtyard and delicious food in the kitchen, but inside King Wan Jin's study, the atmosphere was a bit strange.
"Hu Batian, the leader of the Golden Knife Sect", "Fu Yunshuang, the left envoy of Zixiaodong", "Tao Fei, the deputy helmsman of the Water God Gang", "Xiao Changfeng, the real person of Lushan", "Tang Buqian, the son of Feng Du". . . A tall and thin eunuch was picking up the bamboo cards and chanting. soundIt was so shaky and unnatural. Standing next to him was a short and fat eunuch, with his head lowered and his hands gingerly holding a sandalwood plate wrapped in golden brocade. The plate was scattered with small bamboo cards.
"Ouch," a charming and extremely uncomfortable voice suddenly sounded, "What kind of offal are these?" An old eunuch with silver hair, a bloated body, and sharp eyes like a sword picked up a handkerchief and covered his mouth with a smile: "How do you two slaves work for the young prince? Are these useless 'talismans' you spent ten thousand taels of gold on? Isn't this a joke for the slaves?" After speaking, he stretched out his orchid finger and stroked his gray eyebrows. This person is none other than the great eunuch Yu Ruhai!
The two little eunuchs trembled when they heard the sound, and suddenly made a "plop" sound, and they knelt down at the same time and said, "Mother-in-law, have mercy on me, father-in-law, have mercy on me..." They knocked their heads like garlic.
"Eunuch Yu didn't know what he was doing. Time was in a hurry, and just last night, the maids discovered this next to my father's pillow!" After saying that, he picked up a brown token. The token seemed to be made of some kind of poplar wood. On the top was a carefully carved head of an evil ghost, with three large characters "Ghost Evil Order" written on it.
Eunuch Yu took a look at it in his hand and couldn't help blurting out, "Netherworld Ghost Mansion?" Then he paused, and then said leisurely: "Qingcheng, the people your family has offended are not ordinary people!"
"This is the second time my family has received a ghost order. The first time was a month ago, when my father just fell ill. It is not easy to recruit such good people in just one month."
"My father-in-law's kindness will be remembered by Qingcheng. It's just... these people are naturally not worth mentioning compared to my father-in-law's unparalleled magical skills, but if you look at today's martial arts world, these masters are enough to be regarded as important figures! My father-in-law does not need to worry. As a junior, Qingcheng can only take the piss. Eunuch Yu is like a godfather, and I know that you have a very close relationship with my father. Now that my father has become evil, and Eunuch Yu is so considerate and caring, Qingcheng really doesn't know how to repay him!" This charming young prince who calls himself "Qingcheng" is Wan Qingcheng, the only son of King Wanjin!
"Okay, okay" the father-in-law turned to look at the handsome young man next to him who was wearing brocade clothes and jade belt and said: "Little prince, I have already visited your father and I should have left. But you deliberately stayed with me to drink tea and chat in Yaju. Is there something wrong? If you don't say anything, my family will leave!" The father-in-law looked unhappy and was about to stand up.
Wan Qingcheng immediately accompanied the smiling face, stepped forward to support Eunuch Yu, and said: "You have grown up watching Qingcheng, and I, the little Jiujiu, can't escape my father-in-law's eyes. No matter whether in the government or in the martial arts, who has not heard of Eunuch Yu, the 'Cold Claw'? So, I hope you can stay in Tiger Town Mountain!"
"Haha." Before Wanqingcheng could finish his words, his father-in-law was overjoyed: "You brat, you are the only one with a sweet mouth, haha..."
"Haha..." The two little eunuchs also had a flattering look on their faces and laughed along with them.
Suddenly, Eunuch Yu suddenly turned around, raised his sleeves and grasped the two heads with both hands. He curled his fingers, and the nails on his ten fingers grew strangely long, forcefully inserting into the two heads. Then he followed the trend and threw the two corpses five feet away like carrying roasted geese! These movements lasted only a moment, and the two faces were still smiling, and the voices had not stopped, but the bodies were falling apart as if the backbone had been taken away. The wooden plates and bamboo signs in their hands suddenly fell to the ground.
"No matter how big or small!" Eunuch Yu dropped this sentence coldly, waved his hands in disgust, got up and left. The stunned Wanqingcheng had not yet come to his senses. He just stood there blankly, staring at the two corpses that were spitting blood without blinking, with a pale face.
"I won't ignore the affairs of your Lao Wan family, so you don't have to worry about it!" The voice gradually drifted away. . .
